name: io.github.oviron/slack-personal-mcp
title: Slack (personal user token)
description: Slack as you: read, search, send, files and reactions with your user token, plus a style gate

environmentVariables.name: SLACK_ENV_FILE
environmentVariables.description: Path to a file with one SLACK_USER_TOKEN_<ALIAS>=xoxp-... line per workspace

environmentVariables.name: SLACK_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true hides every tool that changes Slack or local files

environmentVariables.name: SLACK_WRITE_CHANNELS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated conversation ids (C..., D..., U...) that writes may target; unset allows any

environmentVariables.name: SLACK_FILE_ROOTS
environmentVariables.description: Folders, separated by ':', that uploads read from and downloads write to; default home and temp

environmentVariables.name: SLACK_STYLE_GATE
environmentVariables.description: off sends without the style gate
